title: Triage Record
description: Schema for triage records written to Memory as FRESH drawers

issue_id.description: Unique issue identifier — generated by Triage at classification time

recurrence_count.description: How many times this issue (or equivalent) has been triaged — 1 = first occurrence

escalated.description: Whether severity was escalated due to recurrence

classification_rationale.description: Why this severity and type were assigned

route_to.description: Module or gateway this issue is routed to

prior_occurrences.description: Triage IDs of prior occurrences of this issue

synth_triggered.description: Whether Synth proposal was triggered due to third+ recurrence

reviewer_finding_ids.description: finding_id values from Reviewer findings that originated this triage record. Empty when triage came from user/error-event/feedback/retro sources. Populated when Reviewer routes CRITICAL or HIGH findings to Triage.

prompt_injection_flagged.description: True when any originating Reviewer finding had prompt_injection_risk: true. Triage treats these records with elevated scrutiny — do not auto-route, require human confirmation of route_to.
